name: rippit
description: Analyze your support conversations and business data from your AI tool. Rippit builds AI columns over your own tickets, calls, and chats to answer why-questions, categorize at scale, and write reports grounded in verbatim customer quotes.

interface.shortDescription: Conversation analytics for support tickets, calls, and chats
interface.longDescription: Ask why-questions about your own customer conversations. Rippit reads the support tickets, calls, and chats your team already handles and builds the analysis columns a question needs, so it can answer things a dashboard cannot: root cause, theme, intent, resolution quality, and churn risk, judged per conversation and reported with verbatim quotes.
defaultPrompt: Why did customers cancel last month?
Build a taxonomy of what people contact us about
Which support conversations are about to escalate?
